summary: If ansible_network_os isn't set, Ansible auto-detects the network_os plugin for NETCONF; you can also set it to auto (previously default).
questions: Do I need to set ansible_network_os for NETCONF devices?

answer_card.title: Auto-detect ansible_network_os
answer_card.answer_md: If `ansible_network_os` isn't set, Ansible tries to detect the right `network_os` plugin automatically. You can also force detection with `ansible_network_os: auto` (older releases used `default`).
